faq.question: What does Nurana mean?

faq.question: Is Nurana an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Nurana can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.answer: Nurana should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Nūr occurs in the Quran as a term for light.
